captions.detailed: A window-sill air purifier featuring a wide, flat rectangular housing in a matte beige finish. A hinged top access lid, which matches the housing color, is mounted using two black barrel revolute hinges at the rear edge and features a dark slotted grille panel. On the front face, a black pre-filter panel is designed to slide horizontally along prismatic guide rails.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a window-sill air purifier. The assembly should feature a wide rectangular beige housing, a hinged top access lid with a slotted black grille connected via dual revolute barrel hinges, and a front-facing black pre-filter panel that slides out horizontally on prismatic guide rails.
captions.factory: The code constructs the main housing using a hollowed-out rectangular box primitive. It models the top lid with an integrated slotted grille pattern subtracted from its face, then secures it to the housing using two cylinder-based barrel hinges defined with revolute joints. The front face features a thin rectangular pre-filter panel constrained on horizontal guide rails using a prismatic joint.
